# Ubuntu 24.04 (noble) system libraries required by the declared R packages.
# One package per line; blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
# Every workflow installs exactly this list, so a missing library is a change
# here rather than a patch inside one workflow file.

# GDAL / GEOS / PROJ / udunits: sf, terra, units
gdal-bin
libgdal-dev
libgeos-dev
libproj-dev
libudunits2-dev
libsqlite3-dev

# Transport and parsing: curl, httr2, xml2, openssl
libcurl4-openssl-dev
libssl-dev
libxml2-dev

# Linear programming and sparse solvers used through the INLA stack
libglpk-dev

# Text shaping and image codecs: ragg, systemfonts, figure rendering
libfontconfig1-dev
libharfbuzz-dev
libfribidi-dev
libfreetype6-dev
libpng-dev
libtiff5-dev
libjpeg-dev

# Runtime binaries used by the INLA shared objects and the acquisition steps
libgomp1
curl
ca-certificates
unzip
zip
jq
